issues.description: default_raise sentinel and stale '< 3.10' comments left as dead scaffolding after kw_only consolidation
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universally available, required fields should omit defaults rather than use field(default_factory=default_raise). The sentinel weakens the contract (RuntimeError at construction instead of TypeError at call site) and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still references the < 3.10 workaround. Remove the shim or update the rationale.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 globally disabled with a bare TODO instead of completing the Union -> | migration
issues.detail: The PR description promises the Union/Optional rewrite but ruff.toml ignores exactly those rules with only 'TODO: Remove these'. This contradicts the stated direction, leaves the codebase in two dialects, and has no tracking issue or kill-date. Either land the auto-fix in this series or scope the ignore with a linked issue.

issues.description: Debug 'dnf search python3.12' left in install-scripts CI prep steps
issues.detail: The Amazon and Rocky prep steps now run 'dnf search python3.12' before install. That's a debugging artifact, not a build step: it adds noise, slows CI, and could fail the job if search ever non-zero-exits. Drop the search line and just install.

issues.description: install.sh version-range check still uses minor>=7 lower bound while error message claims >= 3.10
issues.detail: The guard reads 'PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7' but the error message says '>= 3.10 and < 3.13.0'. A system python 3.8 passes the numeric check yet contradicts the message. Bump the literal to 10 so the code matches the string it prints.

synthesis.summary: The Python 3.9 removal is mechanically sound and the kw_only consolidation in cmd_classes.py is exactly the right shape — collapsing version forks into single contracts. However, the patch is half-done in three ways the panel unanimously flags: the default_raise sentinel and '< 3.10' comments survive as dead scaffolding in wallet_request_types.py, ruff.toml disables UP007/UP035/UP045 with a bare TODO instead of completing the Union -> | migration the PR description promises, and a debug 'dnf search python3.12' line snuck into CI install steps. install.sh's numeric guard also still allows 3.7-3.9 past an error message claiming 3.10+. NEEDS-WORK: finish the deferred cleanups before landing.
